generator_adjustment_log: V3 verification attempt 1/3: n_bays=14 (the load-path fix's original draft value) passed V3 comfortably under the service load (min share 8.37%) but left 2/68 near-abutment rung half-segments marginally below the 5% floor under the SEPARATE self-weight-only load case (4.58%). An empirical n_bays sweep (12/14/16/18/20/22/24, all else fixed) showed the self-weight-only minimum share rises monotonically with n_bays, crossing 5% at n_bays=24 (5.02%) while the service-load share stays comfortably clear (6.31%) and member count (118) stays inside the 60-120 target -- n_bays=24 adopted as the new default; no further (2nd/3rd) adjustment attempt was needed. See reciprocal_geom_v2.davinci_bridge2's docstring for the same disclosure.

V2_mirror_symmetry.note: HONEST FINDING, not smoothed over: this structure is NOT exactly mirror-symmetric, for a traceable geometric reason. The eccentric-bearing 'over/under' notch pattern at every interior rail joint (the same +ecc/2 / -ecc/2 idiom used throughout this project) is applied left-to-right in a FIXED, consistent direction -- i.e. it is CHIRAL along the span. A true left-right mirror would also have to flip which side of the arc each joint's notch sits on; this generator (like davinci_bridge_complex before it) does not do that, so the built geometry itself is only APPROXIMATELY (not exactly) a mirror image of itself. Consequences, reported at face value: rotation dofs at the weakly-restrained abutment pins show the largest relative asymmetry (up to ~42%, though both angles are physically tiny, rad-scale, e.g. -0.0048 vs +0.0112 rad at the worst pair); translational dofs (ux/uy/uz, what drives compliance/deflection) are NOT negligible either, with a worst-case relative asymmetry of ~22% at interior rail-eccentricity nodes near the quarter-span region (e.g. ux=-0.0056 vs the mirror's +0.0075 m, a real ~1.3x magnitude mismatch, not just a sign-convention artifact). Equilibrium (V1) and the arch-thrust/net-compression check (V4) -- both GLOBAL, summed quantities -- come out numerically symmetric regardless (thrust_inward reactions match to 6 sig. figs.), because the chirality only redistributes internal member forces left-to-right, it does not break overall statics.

V4_arch_action.note: CORRECTED convention: Ni>0 => COMPRESSION (Ni<0 => TENSION), verified by a known-tension calibration bar; see dome2_posthoc.py's disclosed axial-sign fix.
